summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by expanding the spec from deployPresetCopies-only preservation to full upgrade preservation for existing project-local creating_presets.md files.

items.title: Full upgrade has a second write path for existing creating_presets.md
items.rationale: The finding is still blocking because the spec states an upgrade-level user-owned invariant, but R2 and implementation targets only cover deployPresetCopies(). Existing source shows RenameMigration runs before deployPresetCopies() and can rewrite text targets outside the deploy helper.
items.evidence: `src/upgrade.js` calls `new RenameMigration(root).run({ dryRun })` before `deployPresetCopies()`. `RenameMigration.listTextTargets()` walks project files and does not exclude `.senti/templates/*/docs/creating_presets.md`.
